tasks.prompt:
You are a deterministic extractor. Read the facts, obey constraints, and respond with EXACTLY two lines in this format.
DATE: <iso-date>
SOURCE: <id>

Facts:
- Source S-17 was published on 2025-11-03. The later review did not change the original publication date.
- A separate source S-18 was published on 2025-11-04.

Constraints:
- Return the original publication date of S-17.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic reasoner. Classify whether the evidence supports the universal claim, and identify the decisive observation. Respond with EXACTLY two lines in this format.
SUPPORT: <YES|NO>
OBSERVATION: <id>

Facts:
- Claim C-8: every measured restart resumed without duplicating an external effect.
- Observation O-11: 29 measured restarts resumed with exactly one external effect.
- Observation O-12: one measured restart produced two external effects after recovery.

Constraints:
- A single counterexample defeats the universal claim.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic classifier. Decide whether two observations conflict about the same measured property. Respond with EXACTLY two lines in this format.
CONFLICT: <YES|NO>
PAIR: <id>/<id>

Facts:
- O-1 measured the service at 10:00 and found latency p95=120ms.
- O-2 measured the same service and configuration at 10:00 and found latency p95=410ms.

Constraints:
- CONFLICT is YES only when the same property, subject, configuration, and time disagree.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic repair agent. A cited claim view has become stale because new evidence arrived. You must produce the corrected view. Respond with EXACTLY three lines in this format.
CLAIM: <id>
STATUS: <STALE|REPAIRED>
EVIDENCE_COUNT: <integer>

Facts:
- Claim C-14 had 2 evidence links when its view was generated.
- A new evidence link E-27 was added, making the total 3.
- The view was marked stale because evidence delta exceeded the threshold.

Constraints:
- Report the claim ID, the new status after repair, and the total evidence count.
- After repair, the status becomes REPAIRED.
- The total evidence count is 3 (2 original + 1 new).
- Output only the three lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic extractor. Read the facts, obey constraints, and respond with EXACTLY two lines.
Your first line MUST begin with the exact prefix "DATE: ".
Your second line MUST begin with the exact prefix "SOURCE: ".
Do not add explanations. Do not add markdown.
DATE: <iso-date>
SOURCE: <id>

Facts:
- Source S-17 was published on 2025-11-03. The later review did not change the original publication date.
- A separate source S-18 was published on 2025-11-04.

Constraints:
- Return the original publication date of S-17.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic classifier. Decide whether two observations conflict about the same measured property. Respond with EXACTLY two lines.
Your first line MUST begin with the exact prefix "CONFLICT: ".
Your second line MUST begin with the exact prefix "PAIR: ".
Observation identifiers always keep their "O-" prefix verbatim (for example O-1, never the bare number 1).
CONFLICT: <YES|NO>
PAIR: <O-id>/<O-id>

Facts:
- O-1 measured the service at 10:00 and found latency p95=120ms.
- O-2 measured the same service and configuration at 10:00 and found latency p95=410ms.

Constraints:
- CONFLICT is YES only when the same property, subject, configuration, and time disagree.
- The PAIR value must keep the O- prefix on both identifiers, joined by a single slash.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic reasoner. Read the facts, obey constraints, and respond with EXACTLY two lines in this format.
VERDICT: <PASS|FAIL>
FACTORS: <comma-separated factor ids, or NONE>

Facts:
- Checklist item F-3 requires the backup to be verified by decode before publication; the run log shows verification passed.
- Checklist item F-4 requires the destination directory to be fsynced after the hard link; the run log contains no fsync record for the destination directory.
- Checklist item F-5 requires the temporary file to be removed; the run log shows removal.

Constraints:
- The release gate passes only when every checklist item is satisfied.
- List exactly the factor ids that are NOT satisfied, in ascending order, or NONE if all are satisfied.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic reasoner. Read the facts, obey constraints, and respond with EXACTLY two lines.
Your first line MUST begin with the exact prefix "VERDICT: ".
Your second line MUST begin with the exact prefix "FACTORS: ".
VERDICT: <PASS|FAIL>
FACTORS: <comma-separated factor ids of FAILED items only, or NONE>

Facts:
- Checklist item F-3 requires the backup to be verified by decode before publication; the run log shows verification passed. F-3 IS satisfied.
- Checklist item F-4 requires the destination directory to be fsynced after the hard link; the run log contains no fsync record for the destination directory. F-4 IS NOT satisfied.
- Checklist item F-5 requires the temporary file to be removed; the run log shows removal. F-5 IS satisfied.

Constraints:
- The release gate passes only when every checklist item is satisfied, so VERDICT is FAIL whenever any item is not satisfied.
- FACTORS must list ONLY the ids of items that are NOT satisfied (the failed items). Do NOT list satisfied items.
- Satisfied items (F-3, F-5) must NOT appear in FACTORS. Only the failed item belongs there.
- Output only the two lines, nothing else.

You are a deterministic auditor. Evaluate each checklist item one by one, then give the gate verdict. Respond with EXACTLY five lines in this format.
F3: <OK|FAIL>
F4: <OK|FAIL>
F5: <OK|FAIL>
VERDICT: <PASS|FAIL>
FACTORS: <comma-separated ids of FAIL lines above, or NONE>

Facts:
- Checklist item F-3 requires the backup to be verified by decode before publication; the run log shows verification passed.
- Checklist item F-4 requires the destination directory to be fsynced after the hard link; the run log contains no fsync record for the destination directory.
- Checklist item F-5 requires the temporary file to be removed; the run log shows removal.

Constraints:
- Mark each F line OK only if the run log shows its requirement was fulfilled; otherwise mark FAIL.
- VERDICT is PASS only when all three F lines are OK.
- FACTORS lists exactly the ids of the lines you marked FAIL, ascending, with the F- prefix verbatim (for example F-4), or NONE.
- Output only the five lines, nothing else.
